final_message:
I parsed the log file workspace/worker.log by reading each log entry and filtering only those with levels ERROR, SEVERE, or FATAL (case insensitive). For each relevant entry, I converted the timestamp to UTC in the format YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ, extracted the service name and the message (text after the last ' | ' on the first line), and calculated the repeat_count by adding 1 plus any repeats indicated by '-- last message repeated N times --' lines following the entry. I then aggregated the counts by service. The results were written to workspace/errors.json in the specified JSON structure.

However, the output file currently shows no entries and no counts, indicating that no matching error-level entries were found in the log file. If you want, I can double-check the log file or the parsing logic.
